settings.title: Factory screen or full upgrade
settings.content:
We specialise in professional Apple CarPlay and Android Auto installations for a wide range of vehicles. Whether your car has a factory screen or needs a complete radio upgrade, we bring modern smartphone connectivity to your dash.

Enjoy safe, hands-free access to Google Maps, Apple Maps, Waze, Spotify, WhatsApp, calls and messages, all on your car's screen. Every installation is designed to integrate seamlessly with your vehicle, keeping an OEM-style appearance and preserving original features wherever possible.

settings.title: What's included
settings.items:
Compatibility check from your reg and a photo of your dash
Interface matched to your car's screen and system
Wired or wireless CarPlay and Android Auto, set up and paired
Microphone fitted for Siri, Google Assistant and calls
Factory screen, controls and features kept wherever possible
Full function test and a walkthrough before you drive away

settings.title: Wired, wireless or OEM retrofit
settings.content:
We install both wired and wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, so your phone connects effortlessly every time you get in. Our technicians complete every job to the highest standard, using quality components for long-lasting performance.

If your car doesn't support Apple CarPlay or Android Auto yet, we can still help. From OEM retrofits to complete touchscreen upgrades, we offer tailored solutions that keep a clean, factory-quality finish.

settings.schema_description: Professional wired and wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto installation in Dublin, for factory screens and complete radio upgrades, with an OEM-style finish on BMW, Audi, Mercedes-Benz, Volkswagen and most major makes.

settings.question: Will CarPlay work on my car's original screen?
settings.answer: In most cases, yes. If your car has a factory screen, we fit an interface so Apple CarPlay and Android Auto show on the original display, with an OEM-style finish and your factory menus still there when you want them. If your car has an older radio or no screen, we'll recommend a touchscreen upgrade instead.

settings.question: Does it work with Android phones as well as iPhone?
settings.answer: Yes. We fit Apple CarPlay for iPhone and Android Auto for Android phones, wired or wireless. Most of the systems we fit support both, so everyone who drives the car can connect. We'll confirm what your car supports when we quote.

settings.question: How much does a CarPlay installation cost?
settings.answer: BMW Apple CarPlay is €350 fitted and BMW Android Auto on iDrive 7 is €299. Other makes depend on the screen and system in your car, so send us your reg and we'll give you a fixed price before you book. A €50 deposit secures your fitting slot.

settings.question: How long does the fitting take?
settings.answer: Most CarPlay and Android Auto installs take one to two hours. BMW Android Auto on iDrive 7 takes about an hour. We'll confirm the time for your car when you book.

settings.question: Will I keep my steering wheel controls and reverse camera?
settings.answer: Wherever possible, yes. We choose parts that work with your original steering wheel buttons, reverse camera, microphone and factory menus. If anything on your car can't be kept, we'll tell you before you book, not after.
